title: Algebraic Bertini lemma for a generic linear combination
statement: Let $K/k$ be a finitely generated field extension [def-pc-field-extension], meaning that finitely many elements generate $K$ as a field over $k$. Suppose $\operatorname{Spec}K$ is geometrically irreducible over $k$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Let $n\geq1$, $g_1,\ldots,g_n\in K$, and let $x_1,\ldots,x_n$ be indeterminates. Put $\Omega=\operatorname{Frac}(K[x_1,\ldots,x_n])$, the field of fractions of the polynomial domain [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Assume there exist $c_1,\ldots,c_n\in k$ such that the ordered family $x_1,\ldots,x_n,\sum_{i=1}^n g_ix_i,\sum_{i=1}^n c_ig_i$ in $\Omega$ is algebraically independent over $k$ [def-kun-transcendence-degree]. Then $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ is geometrically irreducible over the subfield $k(x_1,\ldots,x_n,\sum_{i=1}^n g_ix_i)$ generated by these indicated elements.

proof.text: Put F=k(x_1,...,x_n), x=sum g_i*x_i and d=sum c_i*g_i. Algebraic independence of the displayed family implies independence of (x,d) over F by the adjoin-independence criterion. The fraction field Omega is finitely generated over F: it is essentially of finite type over k, and essential finite type passes to an intermediate base field.

source.place: Tag 0G4D, lemma-amazing-bertini-lemma proof; invariant-shear variant by Z8

proof.text: There are j != l with c_j != 0. Indeed d != 0 forces some c_j != 0. If there were only the index j, then c_j*x-x_j*d=0, contradicting linear independence of (x,d) over F. Put T=c_j*x_l-c_l*x_j in F. This is transcendental over k: x_l is transcendental over k(x_j), and an algebraic relation for T would make x_l=(T+c_l*x_j)/c_j algebraic there. Therefore the powers T^m are pairwise distinct.

source.place: Tag 0G4D, lemma-amazing-bertini-lemma proof; invariant-shear variant by Z8

proof.text: For m in the natural numbers substitute sigma_m(x_i)=x_i+c_i*T^m and fix K. This defines an automorphism: T is fixed by the substitution, and replacing plus by minus gives its inverse. It preserves F and sends x to x+T^m*d. Consequently it sends separable elements over F(x) to separable elements over F(sigma_m(x)); this is the transport of minimal polynomials through the induced field isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0G4D, lemma-amazing-bertini-lemma proof; invariant-shear variant by Z8

proof.text: The extension Omega/F is geometrically irreducible by transcendental base change of K/k. The variables generate Omega as an intermediate field over K: every polynomial is generated by its coordinates and coefficients and every fraction is a quotient of two such polynomials. The separable-element criterion identifies the displayed intermediate-field formulation with the canonical field extension Omega/F.

source.place: Tag 0G4D, lemma-amazing-bertini-lemma proof; invariant-shear variant by Z8

proof.text: Fix theta separable over F(x) and put C=F(x,d). Each sigma_m(theta) is separable over C, by enlarging F(sigma_m(x)) to C. Since Omega/C is finitely generated, its relative separable closure S is finite over C. Primitive element finiteness makes the intermediate fields of S/C a finite type. Pigeonhole applied to m -> C(sigma_m(theta)) therefore gives i != j with equal generated fields.

source.place: Tag 0G4D, lemma-amazing-bertini-lemma proof; invariant-shear variant by Z8

proof.text: Write x_i=x+T^i*d, x_j=x+T^j*d, theta_i=sigma_i(theta), theta_j=sigma_j(theta). Since T^i != T^j, the invertible linear change of variables gives C=F(x_i,x_j) and independence of (x_i,x_j) over F. The element x_j is transcendental over F(x_i), hence also over its algebraic extension A=F(x_i,theta_i). As a subextension of Omega/F, A/F is geometrically irreducible. Adjoining the transcendental x_j makes A(x_j)/F(x_j) geometrically irreducible. Equality of the two fields from the preceding step puts theta_j in A(x_j). It is separable over F(x_j), so the separable-element criterion puts it in F(x_j). Transporting membership back by sigma_j gives theta in F(x).

source.place: Tag 0G4D, lemma-amazing-bertini-lemma proof; invariant-shear variant by Z8

proof.text: Every separable theta in Omega over F(x) has now been shown to lie in F(x). Apply the separable-element criterion to obtain geometric irreducibility. The base field F(x) is exactly the original k(x_1,...,x_n,xi), by the adjoin-union identity. The invariant T supplies an infinite family of substitutions in all characteristics, including finite k, so no extra rational-function base change and descent is needed.
